crossRefs.note: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.
crossRefs.keyword: declare it. or, number it. he prepared it

crossRefs.note: “Yahweh possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.
crossRefs.keyword: declare it. or, number it. he prepared it

translations.web: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.
translations.bsb: then He looked at wisdom and appraised it; He established it and searched it out.
translations.kjv: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.
translations.asv: Then did he see it, and declare it; He established it, yea, and searched it out.
